items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he had a fellow from Buffalo, Lenny Lewis who was his manager

ctx.x: So how much did you hear Artie’s band live, they only lasted that three months?

Only in rehearsal, they rehearsed quite a long time before they went out. We rehearsed the band before Artie ever got there, he had a fellow from Buffalo, Lenny Lewis who was his manager and, in-fact Lenny had a band up there that a lot of the early Buffalo musicians, not early but you know like Mel Lewis cut his teeth in that band and a few others.
And that trombone player named Ange [Angelo] Callea.
